hooks.name: skill router prompt
hooks.description: Skill router: nudges a request, or a raw discovery reach, toward the skill or protocol that already covers it. Default mode log (records would-nudges, never blocks); NATE_SKILL_ROUTER=enforce blocks the raw reach, =off disables.
